question.text: PFRDA acts as regulator of the pension sector under which Act?

explanation.text: The Logic: PFRDA was constituted in October 2003 and acts as the regulator of the pension sector under the PFRDA Act, 2013. Its remit includes the National Pension System (NPS) and pension fund regulation. The Trap: PFRDA is independent of SEBI, IRDAI, and RBI; the statutory framework under which it acts is the PFRDA Act, 2013, while its constitution date predates that Act. Note: Take care to separate the constitution year (2003) from the enabling Act year (2013) when reading the workbook.
